Chapter 551: Chapter 7: Aren’t You Just Starting at the Ninth Rank? (Please Subscribe)_2

But when they took the initiative to come over… Lin Yuan unapologetically accepted.

“Let’s take a look at the space bracelet,” Lin Yuan took out the space bracelet from the three-headed alien race.

When he crushed the three-headed alien, Lin Yuan deliberately held back some strength, worried about shattering the space bracelet as well.

Once the space bracelet is crushed, the many treasures within would scatter randomly across the multiple spatial layers.

Even if Lin Yuan could find them one by one, it would be a waste of time.

“Really poor, Ninth Rank Myriad Layer Realm, just two ninth-tier secret treasures?”

...

“And a few ‘Mystic Yellow’ crystals amounting to a little over two hundred thousand cubic universe crystals?”

Lin Yuan scanned briefly and sighed in his heart.

However, he also understood that entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, with its myriad dangers, no one could guarantee making it out alive, so naturally, they wouldn’t bring many treasures with them.

Just like Lin Yuan, apart from three ninth-tier secret treasures, he didn’t bring any other treasures either; something as precious as Origin Fine Gold would definitely be kept safe on his true body.

The goal of the three-headed alien race must have been the inner reaches or even the core area of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm. Not deliberately seeking out the native life in the peripheral regions, it wasn’t surprising that there weren’t many ‘Mystic Yellow’ crystals.

“Continue.”

Lin Yuan once again delved deeper into the spatial layers, following the increasingly clear ‘call’, and quickly flew towards the core area of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

…

Within a remote, desolate star domain.

The true body of the three-headed alien strong one emerged from within a certain star.

“That Galaxy Master, isn’t he newly advanced to the Ninth Rank?” the three-headed alien race was filled with anger, “How is this newly advanced to the Ninth Rank?”

Though he didn’t even know what methods of the Galaxy Master he had perished to, because everything happened too quickly.

But just from the many spatial layers he had fled to, which were easily sealed off by the Galaxy Master, one could tell that the number of spatial layers the opponent could open was definitely no lower than his own.

You see, the three-headed alien race had stepped into the Ninth Rank for tens of thousands of years. The Galaxy Master? More than ten years?

“Galaxy Master… how can he be so monstrous?” the three-headed alien race’s heart trembled. The opponent not only swept through other invincible beings of the Eighth Layer with an utterly unbeatable demeanor, but upon stepping into the Ninth Rank, his combat power and realm both surged forward rapidly.

“Galaxy Master!”

The three-headed alien race was filled with unwillingness. Had he known that the Galaxy Master possessed such strength, he would have never delivered himself to the threshold of death willingly.

“This is a huge loss.”

The three-headed alien race took a deep breath. The death of an avatar wasn’t too big a loss for him, and the loss of the two ninth-tier secret treasures carried by the avatar was also acceptable to Oliven.

With the strength of the three-headed alien race Oliven, reforming an avatar would take at most a few decades, plus another ten to twenty years to elevate the strength of the avatar close to the true body.

All together, about a hundred years or so.

A hundred years… in the long life of a Ninth Rank strong one, it’s nothing more than a nap.

But now, it just happens to be the opening time of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

And from its opening to closure, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm lasts only a hundred years in total.

This means that with the loss of this one avatar, the three-headed alien race has nothing to do with the current opening of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Unless he’s willing to directly enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm with his true body.

But the three-headed alien race Oliven didn’t have the guts to do so. If an avatar enters the secret realm and dies, it can still be reformed.

But the true body… once it dies, that’s death through and through, and Oliven’s clan, while strong, doesn’t have a Supreme Being to preside over it.

Waiting for the resurrection by a Supreme Being from the Insect Race, who knows when that will be, and whether or not the resurrection will succeed in the end is another matter.

“Xuanhuang Secret Realm…”

The heart of the three-headed alien race Oliven was bleeding. Originally, he had planned to make a fortune from the opening of this Xuanhuang Secret Realm; with his strength, as long as he did not enter the core area, and stayed away from a few key locations in the inner region, he would most likely not die.

As long as he didn’t die and walked out of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm alive, he could at least gain treasures worth hundreds of millions of cubic universe crystals.

But now, it’s all gone.

…..

Time passed.

Five years in the blink of an eye.

“Almost entering the inner region,” Lin Yuan murmured as he cautiously made his way through the numerous spatial layers.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm was vast and boundless. Among them, the peripheral region was the smallest, and the inner region was much larger than the peripheral region.

As for the core area? To this day, no strong one has been able to pinpoint the exact range of the core area.

“My teacher originally obtained the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path in a certain place in the inner region…” Lin Yuan mused to himself.

In the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, although the invincible beings of the Eighth Layer had the qualifications to enter, life was difficult for them.

Mere rivals to the weakest native life within the realm were comparable to the strong ones who just entered the Ninth Rank. This meant that invincible beings of the Eighth Layer would find themselves in a situation where they couldn’t beat anyone upon entering this secret realm.

If they encountered a slightly stronger native life, they might not even be able to escape.

“`

This is still the threat posed by the secret realm itself, but what about the alien strong ones?

In the main universe, many ninth rank strong ones are restrained by the peak clans and can’t afford to act rashly.

But in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm? There are no such restrictions. If a ninth rank meets an eighth layer invincible of the same faction, it’s still okay.

If they’re from different factions? They’re usually taken out as an afterthought.

…

Even faced with so many threats,

there are still countless eighth layer invincibles swarming into the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

After all, the worst outcome is the death of an avatar, but if they gain something, the improvement to their foundation will be leaps and bounds.

Lin Yuan glanced at the location where his teacher, the Chikun Star Lord, had obtained the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path.

If it weren’t for this ‘calling sense’ from the core area, Lin Yuan would probably go and take a look, to see if he could find any information related to the ‘Xuan Huang’ Secret Realm.

But now that the ‘calling sense’ is so strong, Lin Yuan naturally prioritized it.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan continued to hurry on his way.

At this moment,

a great presence erupted from the terra-cotta mountain range not far away.

This presence was so vast that it affected billions of miles around.

“Is a treasure being born?”

Lin Yuan immediately understood what was happening.

All over the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, many treasures and extremely valuable items were hidden.

That is, the so-called lands of opportunity.

Once these treasures and valuable items emerge, they will cause celestial phenomena.

If other powerful beings sense it and know the location of the treasure, they will naturally rush over as fast as possible.

“Stay away from it.”

Lin Yuan was very clear about his own positioning and goals.

In terms of strength, his upper limit of combat power was close to a ninth rank strong one of the Million Heavy Realm, but he would likely lose if he really faced one from the Million Heavy Realm.

Let alone those from the Myriad Heavy Realm of the ninth rank.

Although there were not many ninth rank strong ones from the Myriad Heavy Realm who entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm this time, there were certainly quite a few, all looking for the chance to break through.

And the treasure causing this celestial phenomenon, according to its induced celestial signs, will at least present treasures at the level of ten-star universe rare treasures.

It will inevitably attract many ninth rank strong ones from the Millionfold and Myriadfold Realms to compete.

Sure enough.

It wasn’t long before,

Lin Yuan felt terrifying fluctuations coming from the direction of the terra-cotta mountain range.

The residual waves of power pierced through tens of millions of spatial layers, endlessly rolling like they would never stop.

“It must be a ninth rank near the Myriad Heavy Realm taking action.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

A ninth rank of the Myriad Heavy Realm can instantly shake tens of millions of spatial layers, and the combat power they unleash is terrifying. As long as you are within these tens of millions of spatial layers, you cannot escape their assault or suppression.

“Anyway, it’s none of my business.”

Lin Yuan continued on his way to the core area.

The emergence of such a scale of opportunity in the inner region is not only not a bad thing for Lin Yuan, but actually a good one.

At least it has attracted the attention of a large number of ninth rank strong ones from the Million and Myriad Heavy Realms.

The rest of Lin Yuan’s journey would be much smoother, and the chances of encountering alien strong ones he could not deal with would be greatly reduced.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes.

“All is going well in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm so far.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. His Taiyang Divine Spirit blended into the multitudinous spatial layers, speeding towards the core area at an extremely fast rate.

However, due to the vastness of the inner region, crossing such a vast range without the aid of teleportation or spatial shifting would take at least ten to twenty years.

“Speaking of which, since I stepped into the ninth rank, I have never tried the third layer of the Black Tower?”

A thought struck Lin Yuan, and he immediately diverted a sliver of his consciousness, following the Magic Jade Mark to descend into the Demon Jade Space.
